project_title: iMagine Store - Apple Authorised Reseller & Service Centre
design_archetype: Swiss High-Contrast Minimalist with Kinetic Orange (#FF7A00)
theme: Light / Dark hybrid (Apple Studio aesthetic - Off-white #F5F5F7 background with stark #1D1D1F dark slate sections and vibrant #FF7A00 accent elements)

typography.font_family_heading: Outfit, SF Pro Display, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

component_guidelines.navigation_header: Glassmorphism header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-black/5 z-50 sticky top-0. Must feature iMagine brand emblem, category nav links (iPhone, Mac, iPad, Watch, Accessories, Repairs), Quote Wizard CTA with #FF7A00 badge, and quick repair lookup.
component_guidelines.kinetic_hero: Awwwards-inspired hero with masked line-by-line reveal text, subtle 3D tilt/parallax image frame, quick specs badge, and dual CTA (Shop Collections vs Instant Repair Quote).
component_guidelines.manifesto_chapters: Numbered editorial chapters (01 Official Certification, 02 Authentic Apple Parts, 03 Same-Day Diagnostics, 04 Express Delivery) with sleek line borders and hover acceleration.
component_guidelines.editorial_marquee: Slow, elegant continuous marquee ticker displaying verified service guarantees and product categories in high-contrast monospaced font.
component_guidelines.parallax_edit_section: Subtle 3D multi-layered parallax edit showing exploded or layered Apple device views with interactive depth offset on scroll.
component_guidelines.shop_catalog: Filterable product grid with category pills, live search bar, spec highlights, trade-in calculator, and 'Price on Request / Inquire' status badges.

quote_wizards.product_wizard: 4-step interactive wizard: Step 1 Device Category -> Step 2 Model & Specs -> Step 3 Trade-in & Accessories -> Step 4 Contact Details & Instant Submission to DB.
quote_wizards.repair_wizard: 4-step interactive wizard: Step 1 Select Device -> Step 2 Identify Issue -> Step 3 Serial/IMEI & Service Centre Choice (Westville Durban vs Express Pickup) -> Step 4 Submit & Get Repair Ticket Code.

component_guidelines.repairs_hub: Secondary yet high-impact repair portal with live status lookup input, Apple Certified Technician badges, common repair pricing guide, and booking wizard entry.
component_guidelines.about_and_contact: Story of iMagine Store (Apple Reseller in Westville, Durban, South Africa), interactive location card, business hours, and instant enquiry form saved to DB.

verified_business_info.name: iMagine Store
verified_business_info.role: Apple Authorised Reseller & Apple Service Centre
services: Certified Mac, iPhone, iPad, Watch & Beats Maintenance
Enterprise Managed Apple Support & On-Site Service

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Persist quote wizard submissions and contact form submissions to backend FastAPI endpoints (/api/quotes/product, /api/quotes/repair, /api/contact).
Build smooth client-side routing and tab switching for all pages (Home, Shop, Categories, Product Quote, Repair Quote, Repairs, Accessories, About, Contact).
Integrate Framer Motion for scroll reveals, text masking entrance, and subtle 3D/parallax editing section.
Incorporate the #FF7A00 accent color thoughtfully on primary buttons, active wizard steps, badges, and focal callouts.
Ensure complete responsive layout with mobile slide-out drawer navigation.
